SDG 5 self-assessment

The question bank includes 8 questions about SDG 5. Each attempt shows 5 questions: 2 informative and 3 motivational.

Question bank

The SDG 5 self-assessment starts from a bank of 8 questions, and each attempt selects 5: 2 informative and 3 motivational.

Each attempt mixes informative and motivational questions with immediate feedback.

Applied model: 5 questions per attempt, with per-error feedback and a result category.
